lore.name: Veyrath — The Dying Crown
lore.description: A dying medieval kingdom fractured by civil war, religious persecution, political collapse, and the failed campaign against an ancient supernatural force. The Crown still holds the heartland, rival powers control the forests, mountains, fen, frontier, and coast, while corruption remains concentrated around forgotten sites.

markers.note: This legendary water source is whispered about in ancient tales and believed to possess mystical properties. The spring emanates crystal-clear water, shimmering with an otherworldly iridescence that sparkles even in the dimmest light.
